a: Gradient is the vector of partial derivatives.
Directional derivative is the rate of change in a direction.
Hessian is the matrix of second partial derivatives.
Jacobian matrix contains first partials of a vector function.
Lagrange multipliers optimize with equality constraints.
Line integrals integrate along a curve.
Surface integrals integrate over a surface.
Divergence measures outward flux density of a vector field.
Curl measures local rotation of a vector field.
Green's theorem relates a line integral around a curve to a double integral.
